source: [Mana Exhaustion has expired!]
target: [Exhaustio Manae exspiravit!]

source: Sam looked at the notification gratefully, then dismissed it.
target: Sam notificationem grato animo respexit, deinde eam deiecit.

source: He then spent a few minutes flexing and stretching, glad that he had the same feeling he grew to enjoy back in his body.
target: Tum paucos minuta se flexendo et extendendo consumpsit, laetus quod idem sensus in corpore suo, quem olim diligere coepit, adesset.

source: Being struck by that horrible debuff was worse than some of the sicknesses he had been struck with.
target: Ictus ab illo horribili detrimento peius erat quam nonnullis morbis quibus affectus fuerat.

source: He hadn’t been playing for very long, but the new feeling of the magic coursing through him, even though Sam knew it was not real, still managed to get him hooked.
target: Non diu ludebat, sed novus sensus magiae per eum fluens, quamquam Sam sciebat id non esse verum, tamen eum allicit.

source: Sam knew he had to be careful because it was exactly this feeling that was labelled as one of the newest addictions not long after the game reached its first anniversary.
target: Sam sciebat se cavendum esse, nam hoc ipsum sensum, post ludum primum annum transacto, ut una ex novissimis addictionibus designatum erat.

source: Still, there were techniques that would let him get a handle on the process.
target: Tamen erant technicae quae ei moderamen huius rei obtinere sinerent.

source: Sam expected, thanks to his inherited memories, that sooner or later he would have to deal with it, but he didn’t expect it would happen so soon.
target: Sam ex memoria hereditate exspectavit, sero aut mature, cum eam tractare oportere, sed non putavit id tam cito evenire.

source: Shaking his head, he gave Lucky a look, thankful that the fluffy, and now shadowy, wolf was still content to sit in his shadow.
target: Caput iactans, Lucky aspexit, gratus quod lupus laniger, nunc autem umbratus, adhuc contentus in umbra eius sedere placebat.

source: Only sometimes poking his nose out to smell something interesting.
target: Interdum tantum nasum extollens ut aliquid curiosum olfaceret.

source: Then took the book he was reading and closed it with a quiet sigh.
target: Deinde librum quem legebat cepit et quiete suspirans clausit.

source: After finally making progress on his runes, he briefly went over all the books that contained standalone runes, making sure to note them down into his new, nifty Grimoire then turned his attention back to his original goal.
target: Postquam tandem in runis progressus est, breviter omnes libros perlustrare coepit qui runas ex autonomis continerent, eos in novo, eleganti Grimoire conscripsit, deinde ad propositum originale rediit.

source: Improving his language skills and acquiring a skill that would help him get more information more easily.
target: Artes linguarias emendare atque artem adipisci quae eum ad informationem facilem consequendam adiuvaret.

source: Some skills were much more convenient to get, for example, Combat Eye, which allowed one to read their enemy and pinpoint weak spots or attack trajectories, but he could collect those any time.
target: Nonnullae artes multo commodius adipisci poterant, exempli gratia, Oculum Pugnandi, quod hostem legere et infirmitates aut itineraria impetus deprehendere permittebat, sed illa quovis tempore colligere poterat.

source: What he was after needed much more time, and a certain amount of relaxed atmosphere.
target: Quod desiderabat multo plus temporis et aliqua tranquillitate requisivit.

source: By the time the other Sam joined the game, the ‘secret’ of the libraries were out, as well as the fact that you needed to actually learn languages to communicate with other races (boy, were the elf fanboys mad) and the libraries were actually fought over by guilds as they would fight over farming spots.
target: Cum alter Sam ludo se iunxisset, arcana bibliothecarum patefacta erant, atque factum quod linguas discere oportebat ad communicationem cum aliis gentibus (o, fanatici elfi vehementer irati erant) et bibliothecae re vera a corporibus guildarum certabantur, sicut de agrorum cultu pugnaverunt.

source: Even obtaining a few books to study was a great accomplishment at that time.
target: Etiam paucos libros ad studendum obtinere magnum aestimationem illis temporibus erat.

source: Sam wanted to make as much of the time as he had available at the library.
target: Sam cupiebat ex tempore in bibliotheca prompto quantum fieri posset efficere.

source: And with the librarian predisposed to help him, he wanted to maximize his gains.
target: Et cum bibliothecaria ei auxilium dare parata esset, vis erat utilitates suas ad maximum conferre.

source: Opening the book somebody he didn’t much care about wrote about the language of the dwarves.
target: Aperiens librum, quem aliquis, de quo non multum curabat, de lingua nanorum scripserat.

source: ‘I’m in a freaking game that makes every game look like it was drawn by crayon, and I’m studying…’ he grumbled inside his mind.
target: ‘In ludo insanissimo versor, qui omne ludum quasi creta delineatum ostendit, et studeo…’ murmurat in mente sua.

source: Then he refocused and began to read.
target: Tum se concentravit denuo et legere coepit.

source: “Um, excuse me?”
target: “Heu, ignosce mihi?”

source: “Yes, young Sam?” the librarian replied, turning away from the shelf she was dusting.
target: “Ita, iuvenis Sam?” respondit bibliothecaria, dum supellectilem librorum purgabat.

source: “I was wondering if you ever heard a spell that would let me analyze things?”
target: “Mirabar an umquam audivisses incantationem, quae mihi res perscrutari liceat?”

source: Sam debated about trying to be circumspect, but in the end, he just shrugged and went ahead.
target: Sam de esse circumspectum conari deliberavit, sed in fine simpliciter humeros eleverit et processit.

source: It wasn’t like his request was such a weird one.
target: Non enim petitio eius tam peculiare erat.

source: Analyze or observe skill was a staple skill of every other MMO, so it was natural that players would want to get one here in Magic Unbound too.
target: Ars perscrutandi vel observandi erat ars fundamentalis cuiusque alii MMO, ideo naturaliter lusores unum hic, in Magic Unbound, adipisci cupiebant.

source: The librarian raised one hand and started tapping on her chin with a finger.
target: Bibliothecaria manum levavit et digito ad mentum pulsare coepit.

source: “Examinare? Examinare… Hem, videamus… Miror…”
target: “Examinare? Examinare… Hem, videamus… Miror…”

source: He watched curiously as the older woman began to mumble to herself, waiting to see if he needed to get more involved, but in the end, the woman stopped her mumbling, her eyes lit up and a big grin appeared on her face.
target: Curiose aspiciebat dum mulier senior ad se ipsa submurmurare coepit, exspectans an amplius necesse foret ei intervenire, sed denique illa submurmurare cessavit, oculi accensi sunt et risus latissimus in facie apparuit.

source: “I remember!” she exclaimed, then reached over and grabbed Sam’s hand.
target: “Memini!” exclamavit, deinde porrigens manum Sam apprehendit.

source: Then, without any word, she began to drag him towards the back of the library.
target: Deinde, sine verbo, eum ad extremum bibliothecae trahere coepit.

source: Sam didn’t protest, just grinned at the success and let himself be dragged.
target: Sam non protestatus est, sed tantum successui risit et se trahi permisit.

source: Being friends with NPCs was really worth it!
target: Amicitia cum NPCs vere pretium habebat!

source: A few seconds later, they were standing in a shadowy corner of the library, covered with even more dust.
target: Paucis post secundis, in angulo umbrato bibliothecae stabant, adhuc magis pulvere obtecti.

source: The librarian tutted disapprovingly and mumbled something about her helpers.
target: Bibliothecaria disapprobatim increpavit et de auxiliis suis submurmuravit.

source: “Heu, cur non paululum purgemus, antequam incantationem mihi ostendas?”
target: “Heu, cur non paululum purgemus, antequam incantationem mihi ostendas?”

source: He didn’t want to clean, but it was a perfect moment to raise the librarian’s evaluation of him.
target: Non volebat purgare, sed id tempus perfectum erat ut aestimationem bibliothecariae de se augeretur.

source: And he was proven right when the woman gave him a tender smile but shook her head.
target: Et recte putavit, cum illa ei leni risu obtulit, sed caput movit.

source: “Don’t worry, I’ll get to it soon.
target: “Noli timere, mox ad id perveniam.

source: While I appreciate the sentiment, it’s not your job, young man.
target: Quamquam affectum aestimo, non est officium tuum, iuvenis.

source: So, allow me to do my job, and provide you with knowledge.”
target: Itaque sinas me officium meum agere, et tibi sapientiam tribuere.

source: Sam simply bowed his head in understanding, then watched as Martha stepped up to one particular shelf and began to browse it.
target: Sam simpliciter caput inclinavit intellegens, deinde vidit Martha ad particularem librorum repositorium accessisse et eam perlustrare inceperit.

source: Then almost a minute later she removed a medium-sized book, covered in dust, but to Sam’s magical senses it sang with mana.
target: Paene post minutum, illa librum mediocris, pulvere obductum, extraxit; sed ad sensus magicos Sam, librum quasi carmen manae resonantem vidit.

source: Holding the book gingerly, the librarian turned to him and held it out.
target: Librum diligenter tenens, bibliothecaria ad eum se convertit et pro eum librum porrigebat.

source: “Here you go, young man.”
target: “Ecce, iuvenis.”

source: “The spell you asked about!”
target: “Incantatio de qua rogavisti!”

source: He reached out and just as gingerly took the book with a thankful nod.
target: Manum protulit et librum, teneriter acceperit, grato capite inclinato.

source: “Thank you, ma’am.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago, domina.”

source: The older woman just patted his head.
target: Mulier maior caput eius leniter tetigit.

source: “Don’t worry, young man.”
target: “Noli anxius esse, iuvenis.”

source: “It’s never a problem to help a splendid gentleman like you!”
target: “Numquam molestum est viro praestanti ut te adiuvare!”

source: After taking the received book back to the table that over the last week almost became his table, he sat down and for a moment stared at the book.
target: Postquam librum receptum ad mensam, quae per hebdomadam fere sua mensa facta erat, redegit, sedet et per momentum librum contemplatus est.

source: He had hopes for what was contained in the book, but Sam was sure it contained at least a rare or higher rarity skill.
target: Spem habebat de id, quod in libro inclusum esset, sed Sam certo sciebat illud saltem artem rarissimam vel altiorem implere.

source: With a slightly trembling hand, he reached out, and under Lucky’s shadowy gaze, opened the book.
target: Manu paulo tremula extendit, et sub Lucky umbrato aspectu, librum aperuit.

source: Surprisingly, there was no light show, no flashes or other mysterious lights.
target: Admirabiliter, nullum lumen spectaculum, nullae fulgora aut aliae luces mysteriosae erant.

source: So, with a heavy sigh, he began to read…
target: Ita, gravi suspirio, legere coepit…

source: An hour later, he closed the book with a heavy thud and just stared at the book and table.
target: Hora post, librum claudidit repente gravi strepitu et tantum librum et mensam contemplatus est.

source: ‘What the hell did I just read?’
target: ‘Quid diaboli modo legi?’

source: The entire book was incomprehensible mumbo-jumbo about mana, mana sight and how it interacted with the world.
target: Totus liber erat inintelligibilis sermo confusus de mana, visione mana et de modis quibus cum mundo interageret.

source: Some of it made sense, some went right over his head, and some he only understood because he had his inherited memories.
target: Nonnulla rationem habebant, alia penitus praeter eum transegerunt, et aliora solum intellexit ob memorias hereditarias.

source: Just as he was about to shake off the confusion, the notifications appeared, derailing his thoughts.
target: Cum paene confusionem abigere vellet, notificationes apparuerunt, et cogitationes eius disruptae erant.

source: [You have read the Book of Fluxus Vitae et Mortis!]
target: [Librum Fluxus Vitae et Mortis legisti!]

source: [Your Mana Sight gained the Mana Flow subskill!]
target: [Visio Mana tua subartem Mana Fluctus adeptus est!]

source: [Mana Flow: Level MAX (MAX%) Your Mana Sight has sharpened beyond the normal, you can discern the greater flows of the mana.]
target: [Mana Fluctus: Gradus MAX (MAX%) – Tua Visio Mana ultra modum acuta est; maiores fluxus mana discernere potes.]

source: [Thanks to your tireless search for knowledge and diligence in studying you gain +1 WIS!]
target: [Propter indefessum studium scientiae et diligentiam in studiis, +1 SAPIENTIA adipiscitur!]

source: [Thanks to your research you gained the skill, Discernment!]
target: [Propter tuam inquisitionem, artem Discernment adeptus es!]

source: [Discernment: Level 0/10 (0%) Your eyes are trained enough to discern the relative strength of those on who you lay your eyes. Thanks to also having the Mana Sight skill, you will also be able to gauge their relative mana level.]
target: [Discernment: Gradus 0/10 (0%) – Oculi tui satis exercitati sunt ut relativam vim eorum quem aspicis discernerent. Quia etiam artem Visio Manae habes, eorum relativum gradum mana aestimare potes.]

source: “Not bad…” he mumbled as he read the skill.
target: “Non male…” murmurat dum artem legebat.

source: It might have seemed weak and useless and was actually useless at this level, but with a few supporting skills, the synergy it would achieve would propel it among the god-like skills.
target: Fortasse debilis et inutilis videbatur, et ad hoc gradum re vera inutilis erat, sed cum aliquot artibus accessorioribus, synergia quam obtinebat, eam inter artes pessimas promoveret.

source: Plus, that was without leveling up the skill…
target: Praeterea, hoc factum est sine ipsius artis gradu incremento…

source: After getting the best skill he could, he finished his study of the languages, reaching level five in the dwarven and elven languages, while also beginning to study the dark elven language.
target: Postquam optimum artem adeptus est, studium linguarum complevit, ad gradum quintum in linguis nanorum et elforum perveniens, simulque linguam elficam obscuram discere coepit.

source: Sadly, he couldn’t improve beyond level five without actually using the language, but for now, that was enough.
target: Infeliciter, linguam uti, gradum quinque ultra progredi non poterat, sed ad hoc tempus satis erat.

source: Then, while he prepared for his meeting at the Silvercrest manor, he began to run around the town.
target: Tum, dum se ad congressum in Silvercrest manerio parabat, in oppido currere coepit.

source: Sam opened an account at the bank, depositing a small part of the haul he gained while robbing the bandits.
target: Sam rationem in argentaria aperuit, et parvam partem praedii, quod ex latronum rapina adeptus erat, depositus est.

source: It was nice to see the stuffy bankers treat him with much more respect than when he previously stepped into the bank.
target: Jucundum erat videre argentarii rigidi eum multo maiore reverentia tractare quam cum ante in argentariam intrasset.

source: Following that, he bought some new, more modern and, most importantly in-fashion clothes for his visit.
target: Post eo, emi vestimenta nova, moderniora, et maximi momenti modis apta ad ejus visitationem.

source: There was no need to commit some kind of lame social faux pas by showing up in adventuring garb.
target: Non opus erat aliquam rationem ignavi erroris socialis facere, ostendendo se in vestitu expeditionis.

source: That was followed by Sam going around and knocking out a few basic reputation quests.
target: Postea Sam circumiecit et nonnullos missiones reputati fundamentales pervenit.

source: Getting herbs for the city guard barracks from the nearby forest.
target: Herbas ad castra vigiliarum urbis e silva proxima acquirere.

source: Getting some fresh meat from the nearby forest.
target: Carne recens a silva proxima adeptus est.

source: Reducing the population of the moss snakes in the nearby forest.
target: Numerum angium musalium in silva proxima reducere.

source: Basically, he went out to the forest and, with Lucky’s help, decimated the local fauna and flora population.
target: Essentialiter, silvam ivit et, cum Lucky auxilio, populum localem faunae et florae decimavit.

source: He and Lucky got a few levels out of it, but nothing exciting happened.
target: Eum et Lucky paucos gradus ex eo adepti sunt, sed nihil excitans evenit.

source: Sam mostly concentrated on increasing his skills and trying to master them.
target: Sam maxime artes suas augere et eas dominari conari se dedicavit.

source: He got two points for Endurance, one for Dexterity and one for Agility on his level-ups, and the bonus points went into Magic and Perception.
target: Duas puncta pro Constantia, unum pro Dexteritate, et unum pro Agilitate in incremento adeptus est, et puncta bonus in Magiam et Perceptionem ivit.

source: The skills Basic Footwork and Basic Breathing Technique were, as their name suggested, basic, but they were absolutely crucial and were the foundation for pretty much every offensive martial art.
target: Artes Basic Footwork et Basic Breathing Technique, ut nomen indicat, simplices erant, sed absolute essentiales atque fundamentum fere omni artis martialis offensivae constituebant.

source: And thanks to his hard work, he managed to raise both of them to level 9, and they were only waiting for a breakthrough.
target: Et ob industriam suam, utrumque ad gradum nonum elevavit, et tantum ad novum impetum exspectabant.

source: Sadly, as they were combat skills, his breakthrough would have to come from a fight.
target: Infeliciter, cum essent artes pugnae, eius impetum ex proelio provenire oportebat.

source: Or if he took the effort to get a proper teacher, from them.
target: Vel, si conatus esset ut rectum magistrum adipiscatur, ex iis quoque.

source: But as of now, that would be a too big commitment.
target: Sed ad praesens, id nimis magnum compromissum esset.

source: Returning to the town, he unloaded the loot he gathered from the forest, earning the adoration of several green soldiers and the grudging respect of their superiors.
target: Rediens ad oppidum, praedam a silva collectam deponit, accepiens admirationem plurium militum viridium et reverentiam a superioribus.

source: The captain of the guard even nodded at him like he wasn’t disgusted by the very concept of adventurers.
target: Dux custodiae etiam ei annuit, quasi non vomeretur ex ipso conceptu adventurorum.

source: Sam counted that as a win!
target: Sam hoc pro victoria censebat!

source: Satisfied, he decided to take a quick trip to see if anything could catch his interest in the Auction house.
target: Satisfactus, statuit brevem excursionem facere, ut videat utrum quid eius curam in auctorio excitare posset.

source: Of course, only after patting Lucky on his head.
target: Certe, solum post Lucky in capite percussione.

source: He needed all the luck he could get!
target: Omnem fortunam, quam adipisci posset, ei opus erat!

source: The Auction house looked like any other building in the city of Ironwood, but interestingly the population inside of it, and around it were a much higher percentage of players than NPCs.
target: Auctorium videbatur sicut aliud aedificium in urbe Ironwood, sed notabile est quod in eo atque circa eum multo maiorem partem lusorum quam NPC erant.

source: Granted, the workers were NPCs, but almost all the people inside were players bidding on items, or looking for opportunities.
target: Dictum est, operarii NPC erant, sed fere omnes homines intus erant lusores, vel res licitantes, vel occasionibus quaerentes.

source: Sam watched as people from several well-known and not so well known guilds and workshops were lounging around, staring at the auction house screen.
target: Sam aspexit homines ex pluribus claris et minus notis gildiis et officinis circumambulantes, in schermate auctorii fixos.

source: He could even spot a few people wearing symbols from the ‘hidden’ guilds that were biding their time…
target: Etiam paucos homines notare poterat, qui insignia gildiis ‘occultis’ gestabant et tempus suum exspectabant…

source: Aside from them, the entire building was full of people yelling, cursing, laughing, and generally just lamenting the fact that nobody had much money.
target: Praeter eos, totum aedificium repletum erat hominibus clamantibus, maledicentibus, ridentibus, et generaliter lamentantibus quod pauca pecunia haberent.

source: He just smirked, then quickly took a seat somewhere where people weren’t jumping around and opened the screen for the Auction house.
target: Simpliciter subridit, deinde celeriter sedebat in loco quo homines non saltabant, et auctorii schermi aperuit.

source: As of now, one could only search for simple items, materials and artefacts.
target: Ad hoc tempus, solum simplices res, materiae et artefacta quaerere licebat.

source: But in the future, they would be able to auction off services, guild memberships and so much more.
target: Sed in futurum, servitia, subscriptiones gildiarum et multa alia ad venditionem offerre poterunt.

source: In some areas, Auction Houses even transformed into Slave Shops where guilds sold the services of their members.
target: In quibusdam locis, auctoria etiam in tabernas servorum transformabantur, ubi gildi officia membrorum suorum vendebantur.

source: That was another can of worms that Sam wanted nothing to do with…
target: Id erat alia res in qua Sam nullo modo versari voluit.

source: The solution the company behind the game came up with was good enough for him.
target: Solutio a societate ludi proposita ei satis placuit.

source: Quickly running his eyes over the available merchandise, Sam couldn’t help but scowl.
target: Celeriter oculos per merces praesto currentes transiens, Sam non potuit quin vultum contritum haberet.

source: ‘Why are they selling all this shit? Those main characters in those novels always find easy gold the moment they open the auction screen!’ he complained to himself as he continued to peruse the rather lean selection.
target: ‘Cur vendunt tot hoc immundum? Illi personae principales in illis fabulis semper facile aurum statim inveniunt, cum auctoria schermi aperiuntur!’ querellavit sibi dum tenuem selectionem perlustrare continuabat.

source: Eventually, getting bored with the collection of random steel weapons, and barely used armors that he could buy at any armor shop, he opened the skill book tab.
target: Postremo, cum collectione armorum fortuitorum ferrariorum et armis vix usitatissimis, quas in qualibet armaria emere poterat, taedet, tabulam librorum artium aperivit.

source: And as he beheld that rather expected spread of common skill book, he sighed but began to scroll down, hoping to find something at least useful.
target: Et cum illud spectrum librorum artium vulgarium, praevisum, contemplatus esset, suspiravit sed incipiebat descendere, sperans aliquid saltem utile invenire.

source: Or, if not useful, at least cheaper than buying it anywhere else.
target: Vel, si non utile, saltem viliori pretio quam alibi emere.

source: Apparently, Lady Luck was with him, because he managed to find a few basic skill books for basic spells cheaper than he knew he could buy them from the mage tower.
target: Videtur, Domina Fortuna eum comitata esse, nam aliquot libros basicos artium incantationum viliori pretio invenire potuit quam scire poterat eos ex turribus magorum emere.

source: Not hesitating, he quickly bought the Wind Blade, Electric Spark, Earth Wall and Water Bullet spells.
target: Nullo mora, celeriter emi incantationes Ventus Ensis, Fulgur Scintilla, Muri Terrae, et Aqua Telum.

source: He mostly wanted the Earth Wall and Wind Blade, as they would harmonize with his current build very well, but the other two would also become useful soon.
target: Praecipue Muri Terrae et Ventus Ensis optabat, cum ad statum constructum suum bene congruerent, sed altera duo cito etiam ad usum utilia futura erant.

source: Then, after a moment of hesitation, and a quick glance at Lucky, who was curiously staring at all the strange people, he decided to bite the bullet and bought the Shadow Cloak skill book.
target: Tum, post momentum dubitationis et celerem aspectum ad Lucky, qui cunctis hominibus miris curiose inspiciebat, statuit audacter agere et librum artium Shadow Cloak emit.

source: It was not cheap at around 100 gold coins, but it was easier than going out and doing the quest for it, or simply hoping it would drop as loot.
target: Non vilius erat, circiter 100 nummis aureis, sed facilius quam exire et missionem perficere, aut sperare ut tamquam praeda caderet.

source: Standing up, he was about to head for the counter to receive the goods he bought when he heard a commotion quickly spreading among the people of the Auction house.
target: Stans, paratus erat ad mensam ad res emptionis recipiendas accedere, cum audivit tumultum celeriter inter homines auctorii diffusum.

source: “Sancte, per deos!”
target: “Sancte, per deos!”

source: “Have you seen this?”
target: “Vidistine hoc?”

source: “How?”
target: “Quomodo?”

source: “How much?”
target: “Quantum?”

source: Sam looked up and watched as the entire populace of the Auction house stared, tense and excited at their screens.
target: Sam aspexit et vidit totam populum auctorii, qui in suis schermis, nervosi et excitati, perspici debebant.

source: He quickly opened the screen and went looking for the item that caused the tizzy.
target: Celeriter schermi aperuit et quaesivit rem quae tumultum excitaverat.

source: Sam didn’t have to look far, as his screen was still on the skill books, and on the top of the listings was one book, set for 10 000 golds.
target: Sam non debuit longe quaerere, quia schermi eius adhuc ostendebat libros artium, et in summo indice unus liber, pro 10,000 nummis aureis, praeberetur.

source: [Book of the Life of Blood]
target: [Liber Vitae Sanguinis]

source: [Life of Blood: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) Grants the user of the skill incredible regenerative blood, increasing their regeneration by 1% for each level in the skill.]
target: [Vitae Sanguinis: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passivum) Oculis artis, sanguis regenerationis incredibilis tribuit, augens regenerationem 1% pro quolibet gradu artis.]

source: It was an amazing skill.
target: Ars mira erat.

source: At a maximum level, it granted a flat 10% health regeneration.
target: Ad gradum maximum, constantem 10% regenerationem valetudinis concedebat.

source: But Sam could only laugh at himself, then continue towards the counter to his new skill books.
target: Sed Sam solum se ipsum ridere potuit, et deinde ad mensam ad novos libros artium procedere coepit.

source: The skill was amazing and incredibly rare at the moment (though when people get stronger, then killing trolls would be much easier) Sam knew one thing that made it one of the shittiest skills.
target: Ars erat mirabilis et incredibiliter rara illis temporibus (quamquam, cum homines fortiores fiunt, trolos interficere multo facilius fiet), Sam unum certe sciebat, quod eam inter artes pessimas interponeret.

source: It was technically blood magic.
target: Technice, erat magica sanguinea.

source: And it tainted the person’s own magic with blood magic, and a sufficiently good Blood Mage could make use of that taint…
target: Et magiam propriam cum magica sanguinea polluere solebat, et sanguineus magus satis bonus illam contaminationem exploere poterat…

source: And thanks to people not knowing this itty-bitty little tidbit, they simply almost farmed trolls to extinction for the skill.
target: Et propter hoc parvum secretum, quod homines nesciebant, fere trolos ad exstinctionem pro hoc arte colegerunt.

source: Which was followed by the Blood Dance, when two enterprising brothers realized the significance of almost the entire player base being tainted by blood magic and only around 5% of them having any defenses against it.
target: Quae subsequitur est Saltatio Sanguinea, cum duo fratres industrii intellexerunt fere totum ludens corpus sanguinea magia pollutum esse et tantum circa 5% eorum ullam defensionem habere.

source: The hunt for them was (or will be) legendary…
target: Venatio eorum erat (aut erit) legenda…

source: Exiting the still buzzing Auction house, Sam headed directly towards the Cloudy Day inn, for a quick cleansing shower and a change of clothes.
target: Exiens auctorium adhuc stridulans, Sam directe ad hospitium “Cloudy Day” accessit, ad celerem lavationem et vestimenta mutanda.

source: Throwing another small glance at Lucky, he decided a quick grooming session was also in order before the visit.
target: Aliud parvum aspectum ad Lucky iaculans, decernit sessionem celerem curandi se, antequam visitaret, esse oportere.
